current_date: April 2024 (document text: 'Local Validation List (Includes National Requirements) – Updated April 2024'; validation page section 'Adopted Local Validation Lists (Last updated April 2024)')
current_evidence: The council's validation-requirements page lists 'Adopted Local Validation Lists (Last updated April 2024)' linking joint-lvl-part-1-householder-v3-final-pdf and joint-lvl-part-2-major-and-minor-v3-final, adopted after the Jan-Mar 2024 consultation; Grokbot's link is the earlier Oct 2023 review draft.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link (lvl-review-part-2-...-updated-31st-oct) and its Part 1 companion are the superseded Oct/Nov 2023 versions. The adopted lists are 'joint-lvl-part-2-major-and-minor-v3-final' and 'joint-lvl-part-1-householder-v3-final-pdf', updated April 2024 after the 22 Jan - 4 Mar 2024 consultation.
issues.evidence: Validation page: 'Adopted Local Validation Lists (Last updated April 2024)'; 'Joint LVL consultation 22 January 2024 to 4 March 2024 (now closed)'

issues.detail: The List date of 2023-11-01 comes from PDF metadata, not from the text. The current list states 'Updated April 2024'.
issues.evidence: Part Two header: 'Local Validation List (Includes National Requirements) – Updated April 2024'

issues.detail: Grokbot did not capture the many local requirements added in the April 2024 list. These include: 17b Biodiversity Net Gain (most major/minor applications); 17c Biodiversity Enhancement (all applications, including householder); 20b Surface Water Drainage for minors with level changes; 26 Sustainable Construction Statement (all new residential, all majors, BREEAM at 1,000 sqm non-residential); 27 Wellbeing Impact Assessment (10+ dwellings or >10,000 sqm); 28a Viability and Housing Mix / affordable housing schedule (more than one unit); 28b Supported housing; 28c Community-led/rural exception; 28d Self-build; 29a Agricultural land (BMV/solar PV); 29b Intensive livestock; 29c Rural workers' dwellings; 30a/30b Employment land and loss of employment (6-month marketing); 31 Tourist accommodation; 32a Water supply management (major non-domestic); 32b Water resources/wastewater; 33 Town centre uses (sequential test, retail impact >400 sqm); 34 LP29 Safe, Sustainable and Active Travel statement (all developments); 35a Transport Statement (50-80 dwellings); 35b Transport Assessment (>80 dwellings); 36 S106 Infrastructure Statement; 37a/37b Loss of education/health/open space/community facilities; 38 Renewable energy (traffic and grid connection); 38 Designing Out Crime (all majors).

Requirements in both the old and the current Part Two list are missing from Grokbot's rows: 11 Structural Survey (barn/building conversions, extra floors, listed building demolition); 13 Planning Statement (all applications except discharge of conditions; Grokbot only has it under Householder as 'not always required'); 24a Noise Assessment for new or extended commercial uses and residential near commercial; 24b Transport Network Noise Assessment (residential next to railway or roads of 40mph+); 26 (old) Health Impact Assessment for 50+ dwellings; 27 (old) Housing Mix schedule; 28 Agricultural Land Assessment for solar PV; 5 Access Plan.

Householder items are missing: 16a Biodiversity Enhancement (every householder application, LP16); 16a Ecology bat survey for any roof works or demolition; 17 Details of development within Flood Zone 2/3 (minor extensions up to 250 sqm); 10 Section plans for excavation (pools, basements, manèges); 11 Planning Statement for annexes and cart lodges.
issues.grok_comment: Biodiversity Enhancement and the section plans for excavation are indeed missing. But Householder already has an Ecological Survey row, a Flood Risk Assessment row ("Standing Advice: What is meant by Minor Development") and a Planning Statement row ("not always required, but may be needed for certain applications"). Those three items are present, though their triggers are weak.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Ecological Survey, FRA and Planning Statement rows exist (weak triggers). Still missing: Biodiversity Enhancement and section plans for excavation.

issues.detail: Several tab_items are boilerplate or fragments rather than requirements. They include the Data Protection statement under 'Submission rules', advice on document titles and drawing numbers, and drawing-standard fragments that run on into the council's address footer ('Endeavour House, 8 Russell Road, Ipswich IP1 2BX Telephone: 0300 123 4000 3|Page').
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'Any personal information contained in correspondence shall be dealt with in accordance with ... Data Protection policy'

issues.detail: The tab_item 'SANGS will be judged against the Natural England's Thames Basin Heaths example guidance' is supporting text from the HRA item, not a requirement. The actual requirement is on-site SANGS for schemes of 50 or more units in the RAMS zone, and Grokbot did not capture it.
issues.evidence: Item 18: 'Schemes of 50 or more units must provide on-site SANGS'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are cut-off fragments that do not state when the item applies. Examples: CIL 'Infrastructure Levey (CIL).' and 'must pay Community Infrastructure Levy (CIL).' (the real trigger is new build over 100 sqm or any new dwelling); Photographs 'asset, using photographic, map, archival and fabric evidence...'; Schedule of works 'the site, a Schedule of Works must be provided'; Flood Risk (Householder) 'What is meant by Minor Development in relation to flood risk: 18.'; Drainage 'by incorporating sustainable drainage systems...' (the real trigger is 10+ dwellings/0.5 ha, 1,000 sqm, >1 ha, or where an FRA is required).
issues.evidence: Part Two item 20 and CIL note

issues.detail: The 'Noise Impact Assessment' row under 'Change of use - prior approval' quotes the air source heat pump acoustic assessment (part of Manufacturers' Specifications). The list does not apply it to prior approval, and the trigger misstates the separate Noise Assessment requirement (24a/24b).
issues.evidence: Item 22: 'air source heat pumps (which also need an acoustic assessment)'

issues.detail: About 17 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The Part Two list applies to all major and minor applications, so these items also apply to Outline, Reserved matters, Listed building consent and s73 where relevant. Outline, Reserved matters and Listed building consent are wrongly shown as '(none) - national requirements only'. For example, the Design and Access Statement and Heritage Statement explicitly cover listed building consent, and Landscaping applies to full majors.
issues.evidence: Part Two title: 'Major and Minor Development Validation Requirements'; item 14 includes listed building consent

issues.detail: The Householder 'Design and Access Statement' trigger does not reach the actual householder threshold: a Conservation Area proposal with 100 sqm or more of floor space, or a householder application with listed building consent.

summary: Grokbot captured the superseded Oct 2023 Babergh/Mid Suffolk joint lists, not the adopted April 2024 v3 lists. It misses most of the 2024 local requirements (BNG, biodiversity enhancement, sustainable construction, wellbeing, housing, transport and others) and includes boilerplate and garbled fragments.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
